title: fix(studio): resolve router basepath at runtime for sub-path mounts
body:
## Summary

Two fixes in this PR, both affecting Studio deployment/navigation:

### 1. Fix duplicate sidebar in `/$package/*` routes

**Reported:** clicking an object (or any metadata item) in the left sidebar showed the sidebar again inside the right content pane instead of the metadata detail.

**Cause:** With TanStack Router's flat file routing, `$package.objects.$name.tsx` and `$package.metadata.$type.$name.tsx` auto-nest under `$package.tsx` (confirmed in `routeTree.gen.ts`: `getParentRoute: () => PackageRoute`). The parent `$package.tsx` rendered `<AppSidebar>` + `<main>` + `<SiteHeader>` + `<Outlet>`, and each child *also* rendered its own full shell — which ended up painted inside the parent's `<Outlet>`.

**Fix:** split responsibilities:
- `$package.tsx` → bare layout (`<AppSidebar>` + `<main className="..."><Outlet/></main>`). No `SiteHeader`.
- New `$package.index.tsx` leaf → handles the exact `/$package` URL, rendering `<SiteHeader selectedView="overview">` + `<DeveloperOverview>`.
- `$package.objects.$name.tsx`, `$package.metadata.$type.$name.tsx` → render only their `<SiteHeader>` + `<PluginHost>`, shell is inherited from the parent layout.

Verified in Chrome against the new Vercel layout:

![Studio object detail after fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a02f4b7f-d29a-4f33-b27e-127b093c54e8)

| URL | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `/_studio/crm/objects/crm__Campaign` | Left sidebar duplicated in main pane | Object Designer detail (Preview / Code / Data, Schema / Data / API tabs) |
| `/_studio/crm` | Empty right pane | Developer Console overview |
| `/_studio/crm/metadata/dashboards/x` | Duplicate shell | PluginHost for that metadata item |

### 2. Unify Studio mount path to `/_studio/` (prior commit)

`apps/studio/vite.config.ts` default `base` changed from `'./'` to `'/_studio/'`. Every bundle now bakes in absolute `/_studio/...` asset URLs and `import.meta.env.BASE_URL === '/_studio/'`. Removed the runtime `window.__OBJECTSTACK_STUDIO_BASEPATH__` injection workaround. `apps/server/vercel.json` + `scripts/build-vercel.sh` updated so studio serves under `/_studio/` on Vercel as well — `/` redirects to `/_studio/`, `/_studio/:path*` SPA rewrite maps to `/_studio/index.html`, `VITE_BASE=/_studio/` in build env, dist copied to `public/_studio/`.

### Files changed

- `apps/studio/vite.config.ts` — `base: '/_studio/'` default.
- `apps/studio/src/router.ts` — simplify `resolveBasepath()` to read only `BASE_URL`.
- `apps/studio/src/routes/$package.tsx` — bare layout (AppSidebar + main + Outlet).
- `apps/studio/src/routes/$package.index.tsx` — **new**, package overview leaf.
- `apps/studio/src/routes/$package.objects.$name.tsx` — drop duplicate shell.
- `apps/studio/src/routes/$package.metadata.$type.$name.tsx` — drop duplicate shell.
- `apps/studio/src/routeTree.gen.ts` — regenerated.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/studio.ts` — `createStudioStaticPlugin` serves dist verbatim (no rewriting, no script injection).
- `apps/server/vercel.json` — `/_studio/:path*` rewrite, `/` → `/_studio/` redirect, `VITE_BASE=/_studio/`, cache scoped to `/_studio/assets/*`.
- `apps/server/scripts/build-vercel.sh` — copy dist to `public/_studio/`.
- Changelogs: `apps/studio/`, `apps/server/`, `packages/cli/`.

### Tests

- `@objectstack/studio` — 41/41 passing tests still pass. The 8 pre-existing failing suites (`api.test.ts`, `verify-*.test.ts`, `AppSidebar.test.tsx`, etc. — module-export and missing-source issues) are **unrelated and pre-existing** (confirmed by rerunning tests on `HEAD` with changes stashed).
- `@objectstack/cli` — 83/83 pass.
- `@objectstack/server` — runner exits clean.
- `pnpm build --filter @objectstack/studio` — 26/26 tasks succeed.

## Plan

- [x] Diagnose duplicate-shell bug (parent + child each rendering AppSidebar)
- [x] Refactor `$package.tsx` into bare layout
- [x] Add `$package.index.tsx` leaf for package overview
- [x] Simplify `$package.objects.$name.tsx` and `$package.metadata.$type.$name.tsx`
- [x] Rebuild studio, regenerate route tree
- [x] Chrome-test: object detail, metadata detail, package overview, root redirect
- [x] Confirm pre-existing test failures are unrelated
- [x] Update `apps/studio/CHANGELOG.md`

(Prior Vercel `/_studio/` unification changes also included in this PR.)
